title: malus × floribunda var. aldenhamensis
intro: Malus × floribunda var. aldenhamensis, commonly known as the Aldenham Crab Apple, is a variety of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Malus × floribunda var. aldenhamensis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. However, limited information is available on the specific bioactive constituents present in Malus × floribunda var. aldenhamensis, and further research is needed to fully understand its therapeutic potential.
